players.product: Neocloud GPU compute platform: sovereign AI factories in Australia and New Zealand running NVIDIA B300 / GB300 clusters (GPU-as-a-service, AI platform layers, high-performance storage); NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.signal: SharonAI 8-K: under the US$1.32 billion five-year cloud computing service agreement with a global AI Lab, SharonAI expects to deploy cloud computing solutions across data center infrastructure in New Zealand (CEO James Manning: 'We are excited to be deploying our first AI Factory in New Zealand'), with revenue from the contract expected to commence across the first and second quarter of 2027. At that date total AI Factory capacity was 132MW, of which 116MW was contracted to end customers, with more than 62,000 NVIDIA GPUs expected to be deployed by mid-2027.
quarterly_data.figure: US$1.32 billion over five years; revenue from Q1-Q2 2027
